facts.F1: Story #6361 S03c Package Forecasting, nwdes feature B of three (the move). Move the 31 Forecasting files out of Services into Modules/Forecasting: the simulation, draw streams, run plan and the two forecast policies into Domain; the forecast, reality-check and filter-rule services, their ports, ForecastLane and IForecastUpdater into Application; the forecast updater and the start-up seeder into Adapters/Background; the four forecast triggers into Application/Policies. Pure moves in their own commits, namespace edits apart. The Flow metrics rule lists name the moved types in their new place. Behaviour-free: routes, DTOs, responses, forecast results, handler order and the schema stay the same. Design: docs/feature/story-6361-s03c-package-forecasting/feature-delta.md (slices B1-B3, Component decomposition, D-4, D-8).

facts.F15: Checker mapping: no state machine or temporal claim exists (behaviour-free relocation), so Quint, TLA+/TLC and Agda are not applicable; liveness is not applicable (no new progress claim, no scheduling change). The dependency-direction and placement claims are checked by the IL-reading ArchUnit rules in the three slice oracles; behaviour preservation is checked by SeededForecastsStayTheSameTest and bash Scripts/examine/bin/forecast-answers-compare (base 39a7f598f vs HEAD). No property-based law: the finite relocation has no broad input domain.
facts.F16: Paradigm object_oriented: owners are unchanged; every moved type keeps its owner and responsibility. No domain decision moves into a service, no new class is created, no type is split or merged. Carriers: decisions stay in Domain policies and ForecastSimulation; effects stay in ForecastUpdater, ForecastLane and the seeder; per-process state stays in ForecastLane.
facts.F17: Handler order and registrations stay: Program.cs lines are untouched apart from using lines (DomainEventHandlerOrderPinTest stays green and unmodified). Tests covering moved types stay where they are; only their using lines change. Stryker file path in stryker.6094.backend.json follows ForecastRealityCheckService in B2.
facts.F18: Behaviour-free: routes, DTOs, serialized responses, forecast results, schema, handler order unchanged. Existing API, E2E and response tests stay green and unmodified apart from using lines. No bound on stored or validated inputs changes.
